SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date, d.fiscal_period_label, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date)) AS distinct_grain, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at), MAX(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 17 AND 22 AND d.day_of_week=7
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows, SUM(f.closing_units) AS units, MIN(f.closing_units) AS min_u, SUM(CASE WHEN f.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS dup_sku_rows
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING s.store_id>=900 OR COUNT(*)<>COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) OR SUM(CASE WHEN f.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0
ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, SUM(f.closing_units) AS units, SUM(f.closing_value) AS val, MIN(f.closing_units) mn, MAX(f.closing_units) mx
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_999_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 16 AND 21
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
    -- closing stock at the end of fiscal week 21 (Sunday 2026-09-27), physical stores, as-is category
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    -- units sold on sales lines in the prior four fiscal weeks 17-20 (2026-08-24 to 2026-09-20), by sale date
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, k.category, k.closing_units,
       ROUND(v.units_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold_prior_4_weeks,
       ROUND(k.closing_units / (v.units_4w / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock k JOIN sold v ON v.category = k.category
ORDER BY k.category
